manifest.name: Player Queues
manifest.description: Configuration of the core player queue management module

autoplay_enabled.label: Enable Autoplay by default
autoplay_enabled.description: Each queue's player controls can still turn it on or off individually.

autoplay_mode.label: Autoplay source
autoplay_mode.description:
Autoplay keeps the music going: when your queue runs out, Music Assistant automatically adds more tracks so playback never stops. Choose here which tracks it adds; turn Autoplay on or off from the player controls.

NOTE: Autoplay is always active when you're playing a dynamic playlist.

options.auto: Automatic — similar tracks, falling back to your library

option_descriptions.similar_artists: Plays a similar artist of the last track's artist, the same way as playing that artist.
option_descriptions.global: Follow the default for all players.

disabled_reasons.similar: No music source or metadata source that can supply similar tracks is currently available.
disabled_reasons.similar_artists: No music source that can supply similar artists is currently available.

autoplay_playlist.label: Autoplay playlist
autoplay_playlist.description: The playlist Autoplay pulls tracks from to keep the music going.

crossfade_enabled.label: Enable crossfade by default
crossfade_enabled.description: Each queue's player controls can still turn it on or off individually.

crossfade_duration.label: Standard crossfade duration (seconds)
crossfade_duration.description: How long the standard crossfade overlaps the end of one track with the start of the next.

crossfade_mode.label: Crossfade mode
crossfade_mode.description:
Crossfade overlaps the end of each track with the start of the next, so playback flows without gaps or abrupt cuts. Choose the type of crossfade here; turn crossfade on or off from the player controls.

Smart crossfade picks a transition that suits each pair of tracks, such as a beatmatched blend or a long fade over a quiet ending. It needs the smart fades analysis provider on a capable system and falls back to standard when unavailable.

option_descriptions.global: Follow the default for all players.

disabled_reasons.smart_crossfade: Not available on this server: smart crossfade needs the smart fades analysis provider and a larger audio buffer (balanced or higher).

smart_shuffle_enabled.label: Smart shuffle
smart_shuffle_enabled.description:
When enabled, the shuffle button uses smart shuffle instead of a plain random shuffle: it pushes songs and artists you've heard recently toward the back and spreads things out, so a playlist you keep re-adding stops repeating the same tracks.

NOTE: Smart shuffle is always active when you're playing a dynamic playlist, regardless of this setting.

option_descriptions.global: Follow the default for all players.

smart_shuffle_optimize_smart_fades.label: Optimize order for Smart Fades
smart_shuffle_optimize_smart_fades.description: When Smart crossfade is active, reorder upcoming tracks so neighbouring tracks are more likely to support a musical blend. Uses only existing Smart Fades analysis; tracks without analysis remain neutral.

option_descriptions.global: Follow the default for all players.

smart_shuffle_song_recency.label: Avoid replaying the same song heard within
smart_shuffle_song_recency.description: How long a song you've already heard is pushed toward the back of the queue. Applies to songs added once; deliberately duplicated songs use the repeat gap instead.

smart_shuffle_artist_recency.label: Avoid replaying the same artist heard within
smart_shuffle_artist_recency.description: How long an artist you've already heard is pushed back. Kept short, since hearing an artist again sooner is usually fine.

smart_shuffle_duplicate_gap.label: Minimum gap before repeating a deliberately-duplicated song
smart_shuffle_duplicate_gap.description: When you add the same song to the queue more than once to hear it more often, this is the shortest time before it may play again, instead of the long song window above.

volume_normalization.label: Volume normalization
volume_normalization.description: Uses the EBU-R128 loudness standard to match the perceived loudness of tracks, without affecting their dynamic range.

option_descriptions.global: Follow the default for all players.

pause_timeout.label: Stop a paused player after (seconds)
pause_timeout.description: How long a player may stay paused before Music Assistant stops it to free the audio it holds. Once stopped, the player shows as idle, and pressing play still continues where you paused. Not every player can stay paused for long.

default_enqueue_select_artist.label: Tracks to play for an artist

options.library_tracks: Only the artist's tracks in your library
options.prefer_library: Prefer library, fall back to top tracks
options.library_album_tracks: All tracks of the artist's albums in your library

default_enqueue_order_artist.label: Order to play an artist in
default_enqueue_order_artist.description: With an album order, an artist plays its albums in your library, each as it plays on its own. Singles are left out. Top tracks, or an artist without albums in your library, play shuffled tracks.

options.random_albums: Albums in random order, each album in track order
options.albums_by_release: Albums by release year, oldest first

default_enqueue_select_album.label: Tracks to play for an album

default_enqueue_option_live_sources.label: Pressing play on a radio station or live source
default_enqueue_option_live_sources.description: A live source is an input such as Spotify Connect or an AirPlay receiver.

default_enqueue_option_audiobook.label: Default enqueue option for Audiobook item(s).

default_enqueue_option_podcast.label: Default enqueue option for Podcast item(s).

default_enqueue_option_podcast_episode.label: Default enqueue option for Podcast-episode item(s).

default_enqueue_option_folder.label: Default enqueue option for Folder item(s).

default_play_action_album_track.label: Playing a track from an album
default_play_action_album_track.description: Choose whether the album continues after the track you picked, or only that track is played.

default_play_action_playlist_track.label: Playing a track from a playlist
default_play_action_playlist_track.description: Choose whether the playlist continues after the track you picked, or only that track is played.
